rejected_candidates.decision: Rejected as-is: full-hit speed/allocation benefits do not offset reproducible small/partial intersection regressions.
findings: Correctness suites passed on both standalone backends.
Full-overlap n1024 reused intersection improved in both backends; full-overlap cold workspace allocation decreased.
n4/n16 zero-overlap intersections regressed repeatedly; .NET n128 half-overlap workspace and legacy n1024 half-overlap default paths also regressed.
Unchanged-code timing regressions and conservative Mono retained-heap flags remain unresolved; they are not discarded as noise.
No optimization version was accepted from this commit.
